notes.title: PEVR Update!
notes.content:
Okay I am getting ready to push an update

-Vehicles now use the triggers to accelerate and brake. // This was implemented because to many people complained about the way it was done.

-Point System

-Daily Missions

-These Two have been tested a handful of times if something breaks or isnt working post in discord and i will find a fix.

- I will not be around this weekend so dont expect an update.

- Have a call out pack I have been working on that will release next week.

-There is other options I have been working on as well and will get pushed out to you all next week as well.

The Voice Command Tolerance Level is there for Players you! to change the VC to fit you voice. 1 is sensitive and 10 not so sensitive. I thought I made this super straight forward. Pick Voice Command .. Select Tolerance level.. Set level.. pretty straight to the point! Most of the commands need to be set around 5 to 7 depending on your own voice.

notes.title: Voice Command Update.
notes.content: Getting ready to push an update to players can adjust the tolerance level for each voice commands them self. Make sure to save or you will have to do it over again!

-Currently Working on finishing up the Save n load system, and the points system and among other things.

notes.title: Development Update!
notes.content:
There has been some talk about the game getting pushed back several times.. The delays have been from finishing up content and also adding some new content as in a full grip system for handling suspects, other vehicles, and a full working jail, along with many other game mechanics.

Games do delay this is nothing new.. Yes, I should have delayed it more than a week at a time but that shouldn't be an Issue. I would recommend following development and doing your research. I have posted several times that there is a discord channel and a Facebook and also a YouTube channel. 

Yes, the price tag has moved up from 19.99$ to 29.99$ for EA release. I have also spent the time to add support for other HMD's. 

Game development is not easy and takes time to test and to flush out things. The main reason for the delay is the extra content that has been added. I made this decision to make the initial game play as immersive as possible. I dont see this as an issue and nor does the Police Enforcement VR community. If you have a problem with this you can contact me directly. If you are interested in playing early contact me and you can get access to close beta to check out development.
